title: Spoke for Philips at a major developer conference in Brazil
summary: I co-presented for Philips at The Developers Conference Connections 2021, one of Latin America's largest developer conferences, on why teams shift quality left.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a talk, not an intervention.
what_i_did: Co-presented 'Less work, more value: learn why everyone's shifting left' in the Philips track.
what_changed: Speaker certificate; about 45 attendees in the session.
